Shaped religious practice and spiritual communities in the Iberian Peninsula. His influence extended to the Catholic Church, which was a dominant force in medieval Spain.

Rodríguez played a key role in the development of the Franciscan Order, a reform movement that emphasized poverty, simplicity, and spiritual devotion. He was a close associate of Saint Francis of Assisi, and his writings on spirituality and theology were widely read and respected during his lifetime.

Pedro Rodríguez's legacy can be seen in the many monasteries, churches, and convents he founded or contributed to during his lifetime. His emphasis on spiritual discipline and community building helped shape the Catholic Church's approach to social justice and charitable works.

The impact of Rodríguez's ideas can still be felt today, as his writings on spirituality and theology continue to inspire spiritual seekers and scholars alike.

The last words of Pedro Rodríguez, 'May the Lord be with you,' remain a testament to his commitment to his faith and his people.
